Computer.file: [swinters77] So what did you get up to this weekend? [jlogan74] Not much, Jerry was out of town again. [swinters77] So I guess that means you weren't home. [jlogan74] Well....I might have ended up at Rhys' house. [swinters77] Jane, this is getting a little out of hand. [swinters77] How long can you keep this up? [jlogan74] I know, I know. It's just, it's hard you know. [jlogan74] Jerry is always away for work, and when he does come home, he's dead tired from all the travelling. [jlogan74] I don't even remember the last time we went out anywhere, even for a coffee. [jlogan74] Rhys was just kinda there. It was a mistake at first, but now I think it's turning into something. [jlogan74] Now I'm in this conundrum. [swinters77] I'm going to start calling you Anastasia :P

[137847] Did the results come back? [137849] They did, inconclusive. [137847] Really? I thought for sure we had cracked it this time. [137849] The cell count is much higher than last time. [137849] But they don't seem to be attacking the host, just sitting idle. [137847] I don't know how many more months I can spend on this project. [137849] Rome wasn't built in a day. Gods have to earn their power. [137847] I don't even remember the last time I slept in my bed at home. [137849] Yeah, I know. Your snoring echoes through the whole lab. [137847] Really? Damn. Sorry. [137849] It's adorable. [137849] So what's the plan now? [137847] I guess we take the latest sample and try to spin the genetic make up onto a new path. [137849] Alrighty. Want to have lunch together today? [137847] Depends. [137849] On what? [137847] Whether they try to feed us that sorry excuse for Salsbury Steak again.
